concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
question: Who among the following signed the Treaty of Allahabad in August 1765 with the Nawab of Awadh and Shah Alam II, the Mughal Emperor?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Robert Clive**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robert Clive**, also known as **Clive of India**, was an important figure in the establishment of British control in India.
 
• He signed the **Treaty of Allahabad** in **August 1765** with the **Nawab of Awadh** and **Shah Alam II**, the Mughal Emperor.
 
• The treaty was a result of the **Battle of Buxar** (1764), where the British East India Company defeated the combined forces of the Nawab of Awadh, the Mughal Emperor, and Mir Qasim, the Nawab of Bengal.
 
• The treaty granted the East India Company **Diwani rights** (revenue collection) over **Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa**, which marked the beginning of British fiscal dominance in India.
 
• Under the treaty, the **Nawab of Awadh** had to pay a large indemnity to the Company and surrender territories in return for British protection.
 
• **Shah Alam II**, the Mughal Emperor, was given an annual pension, effectively making him a dependent on the East India Company.
 
• The treaty was a significant milestone in British imperial expansion and the consolidation of their rule in India.
 
• **Robert Clive** played a central role in shaping the administrative and political structure of British India during this period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Earl Mountbatten**__

 __
 
• **Earl Mountbatten of Burma** was the last **Viceroy of India** and the first **Governor-General of independent India**.
 
• He oversaw the **partition of India** in 1947 and the transfer of power from the British to Indian leaders.
 
• He is not associated with events like the **Treaty of Allahabad**, which occurred much earlier in the 18th century.
 
 
 
• **William Bentinck**__
 __
 
• **William Bentinck** served as the **Governor-General of India** from 1828 to 1835.
 
• He is known for his **social reforms**, such as the abolition of **Sati** and promoting **Western education**.
 
• Bentinck’s tenure was in the 19th century, long after the **Treaty of Allahabad** was signed.
 
 
 
• **Warren Hastings**__
 
 
• **Warren Hastings** was the first **Governor-General of India** (1773–1785).
 
• He is known for his administrative reforms and efforts to consolidate British control in India.
 
• Although Hastings played a significant role in Indian history, the **Treaty of Allahabad** predates his tenure as Governor-General.
